texts.about_this_item: Myau! balanced complete dry food for adult cats, with meat, rice and vegetables. Everyday nutrition enriched with all the necessary nutrients: proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals, with an optimal balance of calories and nutrients. Economy class, made in Ukraine by Kormotech.
texts.ingredient_information: Ingredients: cereals and cereal products (rice at least 4%), meat and animal by-products at least 26%, vegetables (at least 4%), oils and fats, minerals, yeast. Analytical constituents: crude protein 25%, crude fat 12%, crude fibre 2%, crude ash 7%, calcium 1.3%, phosphorus 1%. Energy value per 100 g: 1479.72 kJ (354 kcal). Additives per kg include vitamins A, D3, E, K3, B1, B2, B6, B12, niacin, folic acid, biotin, taurine 1205 mg, copper, zinc, iron and manganese; antioxidant, preservative, colourant.
